paper_title: APT Improving Specialist LLM Performance with Weakness Case Acquisition   and Iterative Preference Training
caption: The exploration of hyperparameters.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates how the accuracy (in percent) varies as a function of the hyperparameter \( \alpha \) for a single series labeled “Dolly.” The x-axis is labeled \( \alpha \), uses a linear scale, and spans approximately from 0 to 5, with visible major tick labels at 0, 2, and 4. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)”, uses a linear scale, and covers roughly 22.7% up to 23.75%, with regularly spaced tick labels at 22.75, 23.00, 23.25, 23.50, and 23.75. One teal solid line with circular markers represents the Dolly series: it starts near 22.7% at \(\alpha=0\), rises to about 23.7% at \(\alpha\approx0.5\), decreases to about 23.4% at \(\alpha=1\), and then continues downward to near 22.7% by \(\alpha=5\).
